title: citrus × latifolia
intro: Citrus × latifolia, commonly known as the Meyer lemon, is a hybrid plant resulting from the cross between a lemon (Citrus limon) and an orange (Citrus sinensis). The Meyer lemon is valued for its health benefits, including its high vitamin C content and potential antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the Meyer lemon include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the Meyer lemon include limonene, which has been shown to have anti-cancer properties, and flavonoids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
